paragraphs: I work on CRM structure, workflows, integrations and data quality. I design the setup, build it and check what happens afterwards.
Based in the Netherlands. More about me
I connected AIHR's customer records through a custom Account object in HubSpot, with workflows and weekly checks to keep the data linked.
September 2026 project snapshot: the core setup is live; enrichment remains in progress.
At AIHR, I built a detection layer that compares HubSpot with learning-platform data through Snowflake, bringing missing links and conflicting statuses into one data quality dashboard.
August 2026 project snapshot: datasets and dashboard are in place; member-count validation and source freshness still need follow-up.
Customer records, custom objects and associations that reflect the full relationship with your customer.
Workflows and integrations that connect handovers between HubSpot, your commerce platform and finance.
Checks that surface missing links and inconsistent data, with a review process for investigating exceptions.
Record interfaces that put relevant information from associated objects where your team is already working.
I follow the data across records and systems, then test the handovers and exceptions. Read more about my approach, including how I use AI-assisted reviews, or explore my HubSpot expertise.
Want to compare notes on HubSpot? Get in touch.
